integrity: Proof is analytical. Included exact integer and high-precision checks are finite corroboration, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp all-time and eventual spectral inequalities are established for N>=7, nonnegative second-harmonic weight and uniform cyclic samples; uniqueness or enumeration of intermediate crossings and comprehensive historical priority are not claimed.
title: Two sharp spectral-order thresholds for sampled two-harmonic von Mises kernels
